title: Zoom vs Webex: Which Meeting Platform Fits Your Team?
description: Zoom and Webex both support video meetings and broader collaboration workflows. There is no universal winner: compare guest joining, administration, room systems, integrations, recording policies, and total cost using your own meeting scenarios.

verdict: Do not choose a winner from old rating counts or generic performance claims. Run the same set of meetings on both platforms: an external customer call, an internal planning meeting, a recorded session if required, and a room-based meeting if your organization uses hardware. Compare joining friction, accessibility, host controls, integration with your calendar and identity systems, recording governance, support, and the complete plan cost. Zoom may fit teams that prioritize a familiar meeting workflow and its broader product options; Webex may fit organizations whose room systems, administration, or existing Cisco environment align with it. Verify all plan-level features against current official documentation before purchase.

faqs.question: Is Zoom better than Webex?
faqs.answer: Neither is universally better. Compare both with the same meeting scenarios and prioritize the guest experience, administrative controls, integrations, recording rules, and support your organization needs.

faqs.question: Which platform is easier for external guests?
faqs.answer: Test browser and mobile joining with real guests, including people outside your organization. Ease of joining can depend on device, browser, security policy, and meeting configuration.

faqs.question: How should I compare security?
faqs.answer: Review current official documentation for authentication, meeting admission, recording permissions, retention, audit logs, and any required compliance controls.

faqs.question: Are webinars and room systems included?
faqs.answer: Capabilities and licensing vary by product and plan. Confirm participant limits, room hardware, phone services, storage, and add-ons with each vendor.

faqs.question: How should I compare total cost?
faqs.answer: Include host licenses, room devices, webinar or phone services, recording storage, support, migration, training, and administration—not just the entry price.
